rows.notes: Headline metric: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. Top 3 copied from the page's server-rendered summary sentence ('X scores the highest on ... followed by ...'); ranking is over every model/effort variant AA has scored, so one model can appear at several effort levels. Weighted average of 4 categories at 25% each: Knowledge Work, Coding, Science, General (per https://artificialanalysis.ai/methodology/intelligence-benchmarking). Site-wide leaderboard also at https://artificialanalysis.ai/leaderboards/models.
